description: This file declares the Shutdown class, which implements the IPlayerTask interface for handling shutdown operations in the Rialto server's generic task system. It includes references to external GStreamer library and a private player interface, and defines the class within a specific namespace hierarchy.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A class representing a shutdown task for the generic player, responsible for executing shutdown procedures.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown task with a reference to the private player interface.

methods.description: Executes the shutdown task, performing necessary cleanup and shutdown procedures.
